proofs.text: Set `origin` to a `dev.azure.com` URL and call `run_remote()`; verify it prints the pipeline URL and `git pull --ff-only`, and returns 0. On a detached HEAD verify it returns 1 and pushes nothing

With `git` and `gh` standing in for every process on the branch `feature-x` and a GitHub `origin`, call `run_remote()`; verify the processes started are `git push -u origin feature-x`, `gh run watch --exit-status` and `git pull --ff-only` in that order, that it prints `Waiting for the purlin.yml workflow on feature-x` and the status table, and that it returns 0. Make the watch fail with exit 1; verify it returns 1, prints `The run finished red`, still pulls and still prints the table. Leave `gh` off the PATH; verify it returns 1, prints that `gh` is not installed, and neither watches nor pulls. Make the push fail with exit 1; verify it returns 1, prints `The push failed` and starts no `gh`

rule_text: `purlin:verify --remote` pushes the current branch and waits for the workflow with the git host's CLI; on Azure DevOps it prints the pipeline URL and returns, and a detached head is refused before anything is pushed

def test_the_git_host_is_read_from_the_remote(project):
    git(project, 'remote', 'add', 'origin',
        'https://dev.azure.com/acme/widgets/_git/widgets')
    assert remote_module._host(project, None) == 'azure'
    git(project, 'remote', 'set-url', 'origin',
        'https://github.com/acme/widgets.git')
    assert remote_module._host(project, None) == 'github'
tests.name: test_a_detached_head_has_nothing_to_push

def test_the_github_branch_pushes_watches_and_pulls(project, remote_run,
                                                    capsys):
    fake = remote_run()

    assert remote_module.run_remote(project) == 0
    assert fake.started == [PUSH, WATCH, PULL]
    assert fake.cwds == [project, project, project]
    printed = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert 'Pushing feature-x.' in printed
    assert 'Waiting for the purlin.yml workflow on feature-x.' in printed
    assert 'finished red' not in printed
    assert printed.rstrip().endswith('the status table')
tests.name: test_a_failed_push_starts_no_run
